spec.description: Community-level energy from cel_community_energy (E31), plus panels 13-15 which validate it against the sum of the E66 per-meter table. 15 panels / 18 SQL expressions against QuestDB. Panels key off segment ('cel'/'grid'/'total') rather than product_code: the same distinction under the name the parser stores, so it survives a provider-side encoding change. See QUESTDB.md.

spec.title: Production CEL au cours du temps
spec.description: product_code is replaced by segment ('cel'/'grid'/'total'), the same distinction under the name the parser stores; it survives a provider-side encoding change (see classify_metric_type in models.py).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, cast(avg(slot_kwh) * 4 AS DOUBLE) AS "Électricité CEL"
FROM (
  SELECT ts, sum(value) AS slot_kwh
  FROM cel_community_energy
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND community_id = '101110-002726'
    AND segment = 'cel'
    AND direction = 'production'
  SAMPLE BY 15m
)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(NULL)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Consumption Validation: E31 vs Sum of E66
spec.description: Cross-table by design: the E31 community aggregate against the sum of every E66 meter in the same community. Both sides filter community_id -- 8 delivered meters carry no community at all and are not in the E31 aggregate, so an unscoped sum(cel_energy) overstates this by ~24% (consumption) / ~33% (production). See QUESTDB.md.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, cast(avg(slot_kwh) * 4 AS DOUBLE) AS "E31 Total"
FROM (
  SELECT ts, sum(value) AS slot_kwh
  FROM cel_community_energy
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND community_id = '101110-002726'
    AND segment = 'total'
    AND direction = 'consumption'
  SAMPLE BY 15m
)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(NULL)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Validation Difference (E31 - E66) - Should be close to zero
spec.description: E31 aggregate minus the sum of E66 meters, per 15-min slot. Expressed as one UNION ALL with the E66 side negated so a single sum() per slot gives the difference; ORDER BY ts + timestamp(ts) re-declare the designated timestamp that UNION ALL drops and SAMPLE BY needs.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, cast(avg(slot_diff) * 4 AS DOUBLE) AS "Consumption: E31 - Sum(E66)"
FROM (
  SELECT ts, sum(v) AS slot_diff
  FROM (
    SELECT ts, value AS v
    FROM cel_community_energy
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
      AND community_id = '101110-002726'
      AND segment = 'total'
      AND direction = 'consumption'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ts, value * -1 AS v
    FROM cel_energy
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
      AND community_id = '101110-002726'
      AND segment = 'total'
      AND direction = 'consumption'
    ORDER BY ts
  ) timestamp(ts)
  SAMPLE BY 15m
)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(NULL)
ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, cast(avg(slot_diff) * 4 AS DOUBLE) AS "Production: E31 - Sum(E66)"
FROM (
  SELECT ts, sum(v) AS slot_diff
  FROM (
    SELECT ts, value AS v
    FROM cel_community_energy
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
      AND community_id = '101110-002726'
      AND segment = 'total'
      AND direction = 'production'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ts, value * -1 AS v
    FROM cel_energy
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
      AND community_id = '101110-002726'
      AND segment = 'total'
      AND direction = 'production'
    ORDER BY ts
  ) timestamp(ts)
  SAMPLE BY 15m
)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(NULL)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Taux d'auto-suffisance
spec.description: Ratio of summed kWh over the dashboard's time range. sum(value) is the plain total: cel_energy holds kWh per 15-min slot, a quantity that falls as well as rises, so it must never be treated as a counter. Gauges need format: TABLE and a query returning exactly one row -- a bucketed query would be reduced with lastNotNull and report the newest bucket instead of the range total. Local consumption over total consumption.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * cast(sum(case when segment = 'cel' then value end) AS DOUBLE)
           / cast(sum(case when segment = 'total' then value end) AS DOUBLE) AS "Part d'électricité CEL dans la conso"
FROM cel_community_energy
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND community_id = '101110-002726'
  AND direction = 'consumption'
  AND segment in ('cel', 'total')
